subject: South Street Historic District Outreach Planning
overview: The Medford Historic District Commission discussed public outreach strategies and architectural guidelines for establishing a proposed South Street historic district covering roughly 20 homes. Consultant Chris Skelly advised the commission on conducting resident-led listening sessions and the required study report under Chapter 40C.

items.title: Communication strategies and resident outreach
items.summary: Commission members discussed strategy for reaching the roughly 20 homeowners in the proposed South Street district, emphasizing peer-to-peer listening sessions, drafted educational materials, and early communication with city councilors.

items.title: Contract details, site visit, and Chapter 40C report
items.summary: The commission coordinated a site tour with consultant Chris Skelly, examined CPA grant possibilities for architectural assistance, and confirmed Form B surveys are not strictly required for the 40C study report.
